about.name:
# Ricardo
Barrios
about.title: Systems Engineer
about.description: An engineer who designs interfaces and AI.
about.manifest: Who's building the future of tech? That's me, a Colombian engineer obsessed with crafting scalable, high-performance apps that fill the gap between elegant design and robust architecture. I live where code meets UX, delivering projects that work & *shine*. Currently as a UX Research Intern at [Universidad del Magdalena](https://www.unimagdalena.edu.co/), I'm finishing my Systems Engineering degree while tackling freelance and personal passion challenges. Why just code when you can change lives? From a [privacy-first desktop agent](https://getwade.netlify.app/) using temporal knowledge graphs and LLMs to a [blind-first navigation app](https://github.com/dejesusbg/truenavi), I build solutions that make a real impact. Reach out if you need an expert hand with Figma, React, TypeScript, Rust, Python, TensorFlow, or Docker. I'm all about clean architecture and code that lasts. Whether it's a [modern corporate site](https://rdingnova.com.co/) or an [offline-first habit tracker](https://auraby.netlify.app/), creating tools that engage users and deliver value. Every line of code is a chance to make things better. In my spare time, I'm [lost in music](https://open.spotify.com/track/3siwsiaEoU4Kuuc9WKMUy5), exercising, or diving into the latest tech. What's a developer without curiosity? Why follow the curve when you can stay *ahead* of it? The tech world moves fast. I move *faster*. Ready to build the next big thing? [Let's make it happen.](./resume.pdf)

layout.credits: Loosely sketched on [Paper](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paper) and coded in [Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/) by yours truly. Built with [Next.js](https://nextjs.org/) and [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/), deployed with [Netlify](https://www.netlify.com/). All text is set in the [Inter](https://rsms.me/inter/) and [Instrument](https://fonts.adobe.com/fonts/instrument-serif) typefaces.
